heading: Operators on the alert that paid for the year

items.quote: The chicken alert alone covered a year of Countertop. Our supplier repriced mid-contract and we caught it in two days instead of at month-end.
items.name: Dana Okafor

items.quote: I killed three dashboards when we switched. My managers get a text when something's wrong and silence when it isn't. That's the whole product and it's exactly right.
items.name: Ray Delgado

items.quote: Labor drift used to hide inside busy weeks. Countertop flagged that our Sunday prep shift was 40% over for three straight weeks — nobody had noticed, including me.
items.name: Priya Natarajan
